request: Build a small Jac web app that shows the status of monitored services. Heartbeats (up or down, with a timestamp) are pushed into the app. A monitor turns DOWN only after a configured number of consecutive failed beats, emits a status-change event only when its state flips, and reports its uptime percentage over the last 24 hours.
acceptance: With retries=3, two failed beats keep the monitor UP; the third makes it DOWN and emits exactly one change event.
One up beat after DOWN flips it back to UP; further up beats emit nothing.
The 24h uptime ignores beats older than 24 hours; a monitor with no beats in the window reports 'no data', not 0%.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Deliver events through an in-process event bus that tests can subscribe to; no sockets, no network, no background servers.
Keep the logic deterministic: time is passed in, never read from the clock inside the rules.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
